mintAuthority.summary: ONED native issuance is role-gated and subject to mutable per-minter rate limits. Separate no-code default-admin and beacon-owner addresses can authorize issuance or replace mint logic; the observed 24-hour default-admin transfer delay is not a global mint or upgrade delay.

controls.label: ONED authorized minter
controls.evidence: At Base block 52095848, hasRole(MINT_ROLE,minter)=true and currentMintLimit(minter)=5000000 ONED. Mint allowance is configurable; this is not an immutable supply ceiling. eth_getCode(controller)=0x. A no-code address does not establish single-person or MPC key custody.

controls.label: ONED default admin
controls.evidence: At Base block 52095848, defaultAdmin() returns this address and defaultAdminDelay()=86400 seconds. That delay governs admin transfer, not ordinary minting or a globally timelocked upgrade. Token source exposes role and minter configuration powers. eth_getCode(controller)=0x. A no-code address does not establish single-person or MPC key custody.

controls.label: ONED beacon owner
controls.evidence: At Base block 52095848, Beacon owner() returns this address; implementation()=0x57ab1e54fca80105a93a735b59f850f8420b5e2c. Beacon ownership can replace token logic; token default-admin upgradeBeaconToAndCall is an additional replacement surface. eth_getCode(controller)=0x. A no-code address does not establish single-person or MPC key custody.

review.evidence: At Base block 52095848, the authorized minter held MINT_ROLE with 5000000 ONED remaining mint allowance. Default admin was 0x9446ce5c9e8b47d7e6cb229a42eaae32d4e8aaf9, admin-transfer delay 86400 seconds, and the beacon owner was 0x8b6fed2d19076f96004df41c78c771b45f4dc71b; all three controller addresses had no EVM bytecode. The Coinbase dashboard reserve-to-supply snapshot is reproducible but does not establish a financially assured issuer reconciliation process or token-specific prudential supervision.
unresolvedQuestions: Controller MPC/HSM safeguards and complete mint-rate-limit authority membership are undisclosed.
Independent whole-token financial reconciliation and legal issuer entity are unresolved.
